versions.changelog:
super-agent 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Integrates advanced agent skills (long-horizon planning, self-reflection, toolchain orchestration, reasoning, continual memory, goal setting, code verification, RAG, tool use) into a continuous, self-improving agent loop.
- Implements a six-stage closed loop: Sense, Plan, Execute, Verify, Reflect, Memorize; each stage invokes specific meta-capabilities.
- Supports interrupted runs and state saving for long-horizon goals.
- Utilizes subprocesses to leverage existing skill scripts, with graceful fallback to built-ins.
- Produces structured reports for each run, enabling persistent self-evolution and improved future planning.
- Includes a self-optimization learner module that adapts strategies based on past performance.
